about: The docs' table of contents. The site's /docs pages are generated from this file and the .md files next to it (scripts/sync-core.mjs in the site repo), so both read the same source. kind = feature pages follow one structure: what it is, In the panel, From the terminal (cli: true), Settings (settings: true), Limits and what's approximate. tools/docs_check.mjs checks it.
